item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
• A recording whose window closes or whose stream stops right as it starts now ends at once. Before, Dolly kept showing a recording that captured nothing.
  • A late stop from an earlier take no longer ends the take you are recording.
  • A take saved while the recording was still starting now opens in the editor.

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
First public release of Dolly. It records a demo of your screen, turns your clicks into zooms, and exports a clip sized for X and Threads.

  • Zooms in where you click and draws a smooth pointer in place of the real one
  • Move, resize, deepen or remove any zoom on the timeline
  • Camera and microphone beside the screen, with captions transcribed on your Mac
  • Exports 16:9, 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 in one go, with an .srt file if you want one

Needs macOS 27 on Apple Silicon.
